core_obligations: Prove that for f : X -> Y locally of finite type between locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces whose diagonal is rig-etale and rig-surjective, f is rig-surjective if and only if every adic morphism Spf(R) -> Y from a complete DVR lifts to a morphism Spf(R) -> X
proof_roadmap: One direction is immediate: a rig-surjective f admits such lifts after extension, and the hypothesis gives them outright.

Conversely, given an adic Spf(R) -> Y that lifts after an extension of complete DVRs R subset R', consider the fibre product Spf(R) x_Y X; its diagonal is the base change of the diagonal of f, hence rig-etale and rig-surjective.

The flat-locus dichotomy lemma makes the flat locus of Spf(R) x_Y X over R either empty or all of Spf(R); since Spf(R') factors through it the locus is nonempty, hence everything, and the resulting morphism Spf(R) -> Spf(R) x_Y X composed with the projection gives the required lift.
difficulty_reason: H3: a valuative lifting argument that base changes the rig-etale diagonal to force the flat locus to be everything.
